To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the MWNT-PBI-NixCo4−xO4 catalysts exhibit superior bifunctional catalytic performance and stability for ORR and ORE.
the pristine MWNTs were decorated with NixCo3–xO4 nanocatalyst by PyPBI, and the resulting catalyst showed superior performance for OER and ORR.
the homogeneous deposition of NixCo3-xO4 spinel nanocrystallites on pristine MWNTs via PyPBI wrapping shows excellent bifunctional oxygen evolution/reduction reaction performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of MWNT-PyBIM-NixCo3-xO4 catalysts with high catalytic activity and stability for both ORR/OER.
the synthesis of a homogeneous and highly active catalyst for OER and ORR, which is expected to be useful for energy-related applications.
the design of high-performance catalysts by coating of homogeneous spinel oxide nanocatalysts on pristine MWNTs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MWNT-PBI-NixCo4−xO4 is a promising bifunctional catalyst with high activity and durability for ORR and OERS.
the MWNT-PBI-NixCo4−xO4 bifunctional catalyst is one of the most promising catalysts for ORR and OERS.
this study demonstrates a new approach for the design and synthesis of a highly efficient and durable bifunctional oxygen catalyst.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the homogeneous spinel oxide-coating on high-quality MWNTs is a new concept for the development of highly active and stable bifunctional oxygen electrocatalysts.
the homogeneous spinel coating on pristine CNTs is a promising approach for efficient and stable bifunctional catalyst.

the homogeneous coating of Ni-Co spinel oxide nanoclusters on MWNTs by using PyPBI is a promising approach for the design of efficient and durable non-precious-metal based bifunctional oxygen catalysts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the homogeneous spinel oxide nanocoating of high crystalline CNTs is a promising strategy for developing highly durable bifunctional catalyst with high performance.
the homogeneous spinel nanocatalyst coating on pristine CNTs without defects is a new strategy to develop efficient and stable bifunctional catalyst.
homogeneous spinel nanocoating on pristine CNTs is a simple, efficient and cost-effective approach to design high performance catalysts for oxygen evolution/reductions.
